tools.name: search_productions
tools.description: Searches and filters film and TV productions. q matches the title only (not companies or people). stage: in-development | in-pre-production | in-production | in-post-production | completed. city / state / country match the shooting location (state is a two-letter US or Canadian code such as GA; UK regions by name, such as England). since = first detected on or after an ISO date; updated_since = changed on or after. Results are newest first. Each result includes its public page url, updated_at, and production_dates.start where known.

state.description: Two-letter US state / Canadian province, or a UK region name

type.description: Production type slug, e.g. feature-film or series

since.description: ISO date: only productions first detected on or after

updated_since.description: ISO date: only productions updated on or after

limit.description: Results per page (free tier caps at 20)

tools.name: get_production
tools.description: Returns one production by slug, id, or productionlist.com/production/… URL: synopsis, stage, dates, locations, attached companies, and attached people with their roles (producer, casting director, director, writer…). Contact details are never included; the contacts field states whether contacts are on file for members.

id_or_slug.description: Slug (preferred), numeric id, or the page URL

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Finds production companies by name substring (q) or company category slug. Returns name, categories, description, website and url; a company's productions are not included.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Returns one production company by slug, id, or productionlist.com/production-contact/… URL, with its description, categories, website, url, and the productions attached to it (active first). Contact details are never included.

tools.name: get_taxonomies
tools.description: Returns the valid slugs for the stage, type, status and company category filters.
